job.title: Senior Administrator - Real Estate
job.description:
Great opportunity in Newcastle’s CBD to join a  leading independent real estate agency as an experienced administrator to take ownership of the sales process from the moment a property is listed through to settlement.

This is the role that holds everything together. You'll be the person who knows where every file sits, what's outstanding, and what happens next, keeping agents, vendors, purchasers, solicitors and third parties moving in the same direction. It suits someone who takes genuine satisfaction in a well-run process and who would rather prevent a problem than fix one.

You won't be doing it alone. You'll have the support of an experienced remote professional and an onshore Operations Manager, so your focus can stay on judgement, oversight and the parts of the process that need a senior head.

What you'll be doing

  • Managing the end-to-end sales administration process from listing through to settlement
  • Preparing and processing listing documentation, agency agreements and sales advices
  • Liaising with vendors, purchasers, solicitors, conveyancers and other agencies to keep transactions on track
  • Tracking cooling-off periods, deposits, conditions and settlement dates, and following up anything outstanding
  • Coordinating agent marketing inc campaign bookings, copy, photography, signage and portal listings
  • Coordinating in-house promotion and brand activity
  • Maintaining accurate records in the CRM and ensuring compliance obligations are met
  • Delegating to and reviewing the work of the remote support role, and working alongside the Operations Manager on process improvement
  
Ideal Experience required

  • Ideally solid experience in real estate administration, ideally across the listing-to-settlement process, OR from closely related industries such as conveyancing, legal, property management, finance, insurance or settlements; who have strong crossover skills and want to move into real estate.
  • Strong organisational skills and genuine attention to detail — you notice the thing that's missing
  • Confident communication with clients and third parties, including when a deal is under pressure
  • Comfort managing several transactions at different stages at once
  • The ability to work independently and take ownership, while supporting a small team
  • Great verbal & written communication skills
  • The ability to work in the agency office full time – Newcastle CBD
Also useful, but not essential

  • Basic trust accounting experience
  • Experience with real estate CRM and marketing platforms
  • A NSW Certificate of Registration or Real Estate Licence
  
What’s on offer

  • A defined, senior role with real ownership of the process
  • Genuine support: an experienced remote professional and an onshore Operations Manager
  • Stable, sociable hours & no weekend work
  • A collaborative team environment in the Newcastle property industry
  • A business environment where growth is encouraged, and progression is a genuine opportunity

Please apply below for immediate review or contact Daniel Boyle on daniel@connectedpeople.com.au

job.title: Senior Family Lawyer | Sydney CBD
job.description:
Join a highly regarded family law team working on complex matters from stunning Sydney CBD offices, with hybrid flexibility and a competitive salary package.

Connected People is partnering with an established and highly regarded law firm to recruit an experienced Senior Family Lawyer to join its Sydney CBD team.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Family Lawyer who enjoys high-quality, complex work while being part of a supportive and collaborative team. You will work from stunning Sydney CBD offices with enviable views, with the added benefit of a hybrid working environment.

You will manage a varied caseload of complex family law matters, working with clients through what can often be challenging and highly sensitive circumstances. You will have access to excellent support, allowing you to focus on providing high-quality legal advice and achieving strong outcomes for your clients.

The Role:
As a Senior Family Lawyer, your responsibilities will include:
  • Managing a diverse caseload of complex family law matters from initial advice through to resolution;
  • Advising on complex property settlements, including matters involving significant asset pools, businesses, trusts and other financial structures;
  • Managing parenting matters, including complex parenting disputes and parenting arrangements;
  • Advising on divorce, separation and related family law issues;
  • Drafting and negotiating Binding Financial Agreements, Consent Orders and other family law documentation;
  • Preparing matters for mediation, dispute resolution and court proceedings;
  • Appearing in the Federal Circuit and Family Court of Australia where required;
  • Negotiating settlements and developing practical strategies to resolve disputes efficiently;
  • Building strong relationships with clients and providing clear, considered and commercially practical advice; and
  • Supporting and mentoring more junior lawyers and contributing to the broader family law team.
About You:
The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 4 years' PAE in family law and be confident managing matters with a high level of autonomy.

You will also bring:
  • Strong technical knowledge of Australian family law;
  • Experience managing complex property and/or parenting matters;
  • Excellent drafting, negotiation and advocacy skills;
  • Sound judgement and the ability to develop practical legal strategies;
  • A professional and empathetic approach when working with clients during sensitive circumstances;
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills;
  • Excellent attention to detail and file management capabilities;
  • The confidence to manage competing priorities and deadlines; and
  • A collaborative approach and willingness to support junior members of the team.
What's On Offer:
This is an opportunity to join an established family law practice where you will enjoy:
  • Complex and high-quality family law matters;
  • Excellent support from an established team;
  • Stunning Sydney CBD offices with enviable views;
  • A flexible hybrid working environment;

job.title: Paralegal
job.description:

  • Growing, progressive firm with a strong focus on legal tech & AI

This is a hands-on role working closely with a busy disputes team across court processes, matter management and the day-to-day progression of litigation files. 

The role
  • Prepare and file court and tribunal documents
  • Assist with affidavits, subpoenas and service
  • Prepare briefs to counsel and court materials
  • Manage court dates, critical deadlines and matter progression
  • Liaise with clients, barristers and other stakeholders

You may already be working as a Litigation Paralegal, or perhaps you're an experienced Legal Assistant looking to move further into paralegal work.

We're looking for someone who brings:
  • Previous practical experience within litigation or dispute resolution
  • Exposure to court processes and documentation
  • Strong organisation and attention to detail

  • An interest in commercial litigation and insolvency
  • A willingness to take ownership of your work and learn

Based in Bondi Junction, with the flexibility to work from home one day per week once settled in.

If you're looking to build your litigation experience within a modern commercial practice, we'd love to hear from you.
